title: Postcards
description: Fields for picture postcards, real-photo postcards (RPPCs) and related cards. Fields allowed on 'catalog' are also allowed on 'instance' so that uncataloged postcards can be described fully.

era.description: The production era of the card, following the conventional US postcard eras. Dates in the vocabulary are typical ranges, not hard rules.

stampBox.description: Text or maker mark in the stamp box, as printed (e.g. 'AZO' with triangles pointing up). Useful for dating real-photo postcards.

posted.description: Whether this card went through the mail.

postmark.description: Postmark as it appears on this card.

postage.description: Description of the stamp(s) affixed, e.g. '1c green Franklin'.
